english.title: Driver of unlicensed hackney carriage found on a stand within the Metropolitan Police District
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the driver of an unlicensed hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY CARRIAGE AND INDEX NUMBER WHERE APPLICABLE..), which was found on a stand within the limits of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869 at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7 of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
driver of an unlicensed hackney carriage
found on a stand within the metropolitan police district or City of London

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: It is a defence for the driver to prove that he was ignorant of the fact of the carriage being an unlicensed carriage - section 7 of the Act
